# sniffCSS

> sniffCSS is a high-performance Rust CLI that captures the **real computed CSS
> styles** of DOM elements from a live page (especially localhost) via the raw
> Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) over WebSocket — no puppeteer/chromiumoxide —
> and emits structured, compact JSONL optimized for consumption by AI agents. It
> also ships deterministic diffing (`sniffCSS-diff`), deterministic
> a11y/consistency checks (`sniffCSS-check`), and an MCP server
> (`sniffCSS-mcp`) so a model gets only a minimal delta to interpret instead of
> raw snapshots.

Things to remember when using sniffCSS:

- Talks to the browser over raw CDP; needs Chrome/Chromium on the system (or `--chrome PATH` / `SNIFF_CHROME_PATH`), or attaches to a running browser via `--connect`.
- Default output is the **summary digest** (token-lean, ~5-10x smaller than full); `--no-summary` emits the full JSONL used by diff/check/jq.
- **AI-optimized by default**: `-u URL -s SEL` already enables `--compact`, `--custom-props`, `--stabilize`, `--contrast` and `--ax`. `--full` disables all five; `--no-*` give fine control.
- **Determinism is a contract**: both diff sides must share mode (default+default or `--full`+`--full`, never mixed), viewport, wait strategy and actions.
- **The AI only judges**: cite the measured facets (`contrast.ratio`, `aria.name`, `accessibility_grade`, `ax.role`); never re-derive them or feed full snapshots to the model — diff/check first.
- Interactions reveal action-only elements: `--click`/`--hover`/`--type`/`--upload`/`--action` (real trusted input events); `--header`/`--storage-state`/`--save-storage-state` handle auth + persistent sessions.
- `sniffCSS-check` is fully offline and LLM-free (`--uniform` finds the odd card; `--rules` emits PASS/WARN/FAIL for contrast, 24px targets, focus, alt).
- **Flutter/Dart backend**: `--backend flutter` (CLI) / `sniffFlutter_page` (MCP) captures a **debug-mode** Flutter app's widget tree on an Android emulator/device over the Dart VM Service (`flutter run/attach --machine` + `ext.flutter.inspector.*`), emitting the same JSONL model (widget class as tag, colors normalized to `#rrggbb`, shared WCAG contrast) so the same `sniffCSS-diff`/`sniffCSS-check` work by path. Requires `--device <serial>` or `--avd <name>`; release builds (no VM Service) are unsupported.

### Key facts

- Categories: `box-model` · `layout` · `typography` · `visual` · `transform` · `animation` · `interaction` · `accessibility` · `all`.
- Wait strategies: `selector`, `network-idle`, `element-ready`, `fonts-loaded`, `app-flag`, `delay`. Default: selector (10s) → network-idle (30s) → element-ready (10s, visible+has-size).
- `sniffCSS-diff base.jsonl head.jsonl --tolerance 0.5` emits `CHANGED`/`ADDED`/`REMOVED` + `__diff_summary`; `--stats-only` for scale.
- `sniffCSS-check --input snap.jsonl --uniform --rules` emits PASS/WARN/FAIL + `__check_summary`.
- MCP tools over stdio: `sniffCSS_page`, `sniffFlutter_page`, `sniffCSS_diff`, `sniffCSS_check`, `sniffCSS_snapshots`, `sniffCSS_categories`. Snapshots persist to `sniffCSS/[domain]/[UTC]-[path]-[selector].jsonl` (git-ignored); diff/check run path-first so full JSONL never enters the LLM context.
- Embedded resources: `sniffCSS://prompts/eval`, `sniffCSS://schemas/eval`, `sniffCSS://guides/golden`.
- Install: `curl ... | sh` (`install.sh`), binaries per GitHub Release; Docker Hub image `stallonels/sniffcss` (multi-arch). MSRV 1.88.

## Examples

- Capture a button's computed styles: `sniffCSS --url http://localhost:3000 --selector ".btn-primary"`.
- Deterministic regression diff in CI:

```bash
sniffCSS -u "$URL" -s "$SEL" --no-summary --stable-key data-testid > snapshots/base.jsonl
# ... deploy ...
sniffCSS -u "$URL" -s "$SEL" --no-summary --stable-key data-testid > snapshots/head.jsonl
sniffCSS-diff snapshots/base.jsonl snapshots/head.jsonl --stats-only
```

- Reveal action-only elements: `sniffCSS -u "$URL" -s ".modal" --click "#open-modal"`.
- Serve as MCP for AI agents: `sniffCSS-mcp` (stdio, shares one headless Chrome).
